notes_for_editor: No build date, design or height appears in any source read. The agency comes from one Forest Lookouts list line with no date. The 2010 note does not date the removal. The 1971 station description is the only evidence the tower stood then. The brief's registers field lists NGS, a survey registry rather than a lookout register; left unchanged. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the 1971 'set' wording rests on the datasheet's history line (1971 MONUMENTED NCGS). The story's earlier 'to reach it' gloss was dropped because the 2010 note's four-wheel-drive line gives no object, and the 1971 sentence now carries its own footnote.
